claude_result_text:
The `upper_deck_hump` (weight 1.5) was the weakest feature of this candidate, scoring poorly due to a lack of an iconic 747 hump or having it represented as a crude block. I have added a two-sphere "hump" assembly (`humpGroup`) consisting of `mainHump` and `noseHump`. This creates a distinct partial-length upper deck that begins at the nose (around X=28) and blends down smoothly into the crown within the front third of the fuselage. I chose `SphereGeometry` to ensure it is "smoothly faired" as requested by the 10-point anchor, rather than using a blocky primitive which had previously regressed the score.

This edit was targeted specifically at the hump geometry without altering the wings, engines, or other high-scoring components.
